name: Artemis, Moon Huntress
loreTies: Artemis embodies moon hunt, wilderness thresholds, bow discipline, and untamed protection within The Celestial Heights of Olympus.
The Laurel-Sky Gate allows this deity to enter Ascension-era dungeon routes without collapsing the individuality of other Realms.
Olympian culture, symbols, weapons, and divine law shape every ability, artifact, silhouette, and combat choice.
shortBackstory: Artemis, Moon Huntress, is a playable goddess in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Artemis is the true source-realm divinity behind the mythology — moon hunt, wilderness thresholds, bow discipline, and untamed protection. Ascension expands divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not turn a mortal into a god.

chapters.title: Divine Origin
chapters.text: Artemis is not a mortal hero inspired by myth. Artemis is the actual goddess recognized by Olympian source culture, born from the supernatural laws of The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Their domain — moon hunt, wilderness thresholds, bow discipline, and untamed protection — determines their symbols, weapons, posture, combat instincts, and relationship to sacred authority.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Within Olympian, Artemis expresses the civilization rather than merely representing it. Their visual identity must carry the materials, beauty standards, divine symbols, and sacred rules of The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Their gameplay role, Breaker, must grow from mythology first and mechanics second.

chapters.title: Mythos Gate Wound
chapters.text: During the Ascension era, Artemis can interact with The Laurel-Sky Gate because divine beings are intrinsically connected to their Realms. The Gate does not become a simple teleportation portal; it is a mysterious boundary where separate mythological realities become traversable. Artemis understands some rites of crossing, but not the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

chapters.title: Dungeon Role
chapters.text: When selected by the player, Artemis enters the dungeon alone as one god or goddess against multiple enemies. No army follows. No squad shares control. Every room, trap, shrine, relic, elite, and boss encounter must test how moon hunt, wilderness thresholds, bow discipline, and untamed protection survives pressure from creatures, rival Realm laws, and unstable Gate conditions.

chapters.title: Ascension Conflict
chapters.text: Ascension is the current story arc, not the permanent end-state of the Mythos Gates universe. For Artemis, Ascension means restoration, awakening, evolution, or expansion of existing divine power. Their personal conflict is to recover strength without reducing Olympian mythology into raw fuel for the crisis.

relationshipHooks: Faction witnesses interpret how Artemis crosses The Laurel-Sky Gate.
Rival deities challenge the limits of cross-Realm travel.
Dungeon lore pickups reveal Gate mystery without resolving the full origin.
developmentStatus: Playable deity backstory aligned to Mythos Gates identity, one-deity dungeon runs, current Ascension arc, and preserved Lore Codex canon.
mythicSource: source culture humans later copied as Greek myth
visualCanon: Lyrion is a laurel-envoy of contest law: part diplomat, part oracle usher, part arena architect. His bronze, marble-light, laurel seals, and measured beauty should feel like the origin of later Greek diplomatic and athletic sacred culture.

mythosGatesCanon.identityRule: Artemis is the actual goddess of Olympian source mythology, never a mortal hero or generic champion.
mythosGatesCanon.arcRule: Ascension restores, awakens, evolves, or expands existing divine power; it does not make the character a god for the first time.
mythosGatesCanon.mysteryRule: The backstory may reveal how this deity interacts with the Mythos Gates, but must not resolve the full origin of the Gates.
